_doc: Fixed prompts for the painted card pass (owner_rulings.md ruling 30; art/tools/paint_card.py). A card's prompt = style + subject (per card, from the fighter's brief and palette) + light (filled from the card's plate: its sun side and glow colour) + eyes + rules + the imagegen SENSITIVITY line. Change a prompt only with a new version number: paint.json beside the cards records the version and the full text that made each card. Version 2 (cards third pass, verify 2): no added colour or part; the lens's blue ring is the figure's only blue; Long Evening keeps the render's warm festival grade (lead call: the render is canonical); the Shadeprint mask is ruling 2's amber lacquer with dark lidded eyes; Sukri's mask has no lines below the eyes. Version 3 (cards pass 4): paint only what the reference shows (a part named in the subject that is out of frame stays out: Sukri's portrait gained a crook and cup), no added light source, sun disc or lens, keep the reference's brightness (Highrim's portrait lifted the draft cell); a hands line (the card hands now have fingers, knuckles and a thumb: keep them); Sukri's cheeks and the band under the eyes are smooth unmarked wood on every Sukri card; the Shadeprint mask keeps its rendered amber (it turned saturated orange). cards_portrait: a portrait's subject when it differs (Sukri's staff, crook and cup are out of a portrait's frame; naming them made the painter add them, 3 of 3 variants in pass 4). v3 splash retry (same pass): Sukri's and Stillwater's splash subjects ask for a light paint on the face (the painter streaked the mask's grain in 6 of 6 splash variants; the portraits, painted lightly, held).
style: Repaint this exact image as one finished, hand-painted fantasy game key-art illustration: painterly brushwork with soft and lost edges over the figure and the landscape alike, painted form and light, a rich value structure. Keep the composition, the camera, the framing, the background layout and the character's pose, silhouette, proportions, costume parts and colours exactly as in the reference. Do not add or remove props, limbs or figures; do not move, turn or resize the character. Add no colour, ornament, band or part that is not in the reference. Paint only what is visible in the reference: anything described below that is out of frame stays out of frame. Add no object, light source, sun disc, lens or prop that the reference does not show. Keep the reference's overall brightness and the background's value; do not brighten the image.
light: Light: a low {glow} sun from the {side}, a warm rim light along the character's {side} edges, cooler shadow on the far side, a soft shadow cast from the feet onto the ground they stand on.
light_portrait: Light: a low {glow} sun from the {side}, a warm rim light along the character's {side} edges, cooler shadow on the far side.
eyes: Eyes: alive, with upper lids and dark pupils, looking out; never glowing, never solid colour, never empty or hollow, no bright or saturated ring round the iris.
rules: Painted form, not a 3D render; no outline halo. No text, no letters, no logo, no signature, no border, no frame.

cards.kemdo: The character: a lean wanderer in a soft, low, rounded cream linen hood, a carved sandstone brow band over a dark eye slit with two eyes, the lower face wrapped in cream linen bands, cream wrapped robes with a tan sash, a stone pauldron on one shoulder in the reference's colour, laced tan boots, holding a tall wooden staff topped by a round glass lens in a pale frame edged with a thin blue ring (the only blue on the figure).
cards.kemdo_highrim: The character: a lean wanderer in a soft, low, rounded pale stone-white hood, a warm sand-coloured face wrap a clear step darker than the hood, a carved brow band over a dark eye slit with two eyes, pale dusty robes with a grey-brown sash, charcoal-brown leggings and laced boots, holding a tall staff topped by a round lens in a white frame edged with a thin blue ring (the only blue on the figure; the rolled clasp on the chest is plain cream).
cards.kemdo_long_evening: The scene is lit warm by festival lanterns, and the figure's colours in the reference are canonical: keep every colour exactly as rendered, warm peach and rose in the lantern light; do not recolour the hood or robe to lilac or grey. The character: a lean wanderer in a soft, low, rounded hood and face wrap, a carved brow band over a dark eye slit with two eyes, wrapped robes with small painted lanterns along the hem, a sash, rose bound legs and boots, holding a lens in a smoked-amber frame low before her.
cards.sukri: The character: a small, round hooded wanderer: a soft, low, rounded cream hood, a smooth carved warm wooden face mask with a gentle smile and honey-amber almond eyes, thick cream wrap bands round a barrel body, a tan sash, brown bloomers and boots, a plain walking staff with a crook from which a small glass cup of warm light hangs. The cheeks and the band under the eyes are smooth, polished, unmarked wood: no grain, crack, line or streak there, and never a line running down from an eye. Paint the face lightly: keep the rendered mask, its eyes, nose and smile exactly as in the reference, with soft painted light only; add no grain, line or crack to it.
cards.sukri_stillwater: The character: a small, round hooded wanderer: a soft, low, rounded pale stone hood, a carved warm wooden face mask with a gentle smile and honey-amber almond eyes, sea-glass grey-green wrap bands round a barrel body, dark slate leggings and boots, a pale walking staff with a crook from which a small pale-teal glass cup hangs. The cheeks and the band under the eyes are smooth, polished, unmarked wood: no grain, crack, line or streak there, and never a line running down from an eye. Paint the face lightly: keep the rendered mask, its eyes, nose and smile exactly as in the reference, with soft painted light only; add no grain, line or crack to it.
cards.sukri_shadeprint: The character: a small, round hooded wanderer: a soft, low, rounded pale lilac hood and pale lilac shoulder plates, a smooth warm amber lacquer face mask in exactly the rendered amber (#B39272 under the violet dusk light; never orange, never pale) with a gentle smile, dark amber eyes under a soft lid shadow with dark pupils and no bright ring, no lines on the cheeks or jaw, ink-violet wraps with continuous mid-violet spiral bands round a barrel body, dark violet leggings and boots, a pale walking staff with a crook from which a small violet glass cup hangs. The cheeks and the band under the eyes are smooth, polished, unmarked wood: no grain, crack, line or streak there, and never a line running down from an eye.

hand: Repaint only the hand in the middle of this crop as a well-drawn, hand-painted hand: {what}, with distinct fingers, knuckles and a thumb, soft painted form and the same light. Keep its position, size, pose and colours, and keep everything else in the crop exactly as it is. No new objects, no text.
hands: Hands: gloved hands with separate fingers, knuckles and a thumb exactly as in the reference, each finger where it is rendered; never a mitten, a block or fused fingers.
